  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors

      title: Validation message

      type: object
      properties:
        message:

      required:
        - message

## Summary

I changed telephone handling from a 10-digit format to E.164 form.

**New normalization logic** — `src/main/java/.../rest/function/owner/Telephones.java`:
- Strips spaces, dashes and brackets.
- If a leading `+` is present, keeps it and the country code as supplied.
- Otherwise assumes country code `+61` and drops a single leading `0` from the national digits.
- Requires 8–15 digits after the `+`, throwing `InvalidTelephoneException` (→ 400) otherwise.
- So `0412 345 678` → `+61412345678`, and `+64 21 123 456` → `+6421123456`.

**Wiring the change in:**
- `BuildOwner.java` — replaced the old "strip non-digits, require exactly 10" logic with `Telephones.toE164(...)`, so the stored/returned `telephone` is the E.164 string.
- `EnsureUniqueTelephone` already compares `owner.getTelephone()` against `findByTelephone(...)`, so duplicate detection now naturally compares E.164 values (no change needed there).
- `Owner.java` entity — updated the bean-validation constraints from `@Digits`/`@Pattern("^[0-9]{10}$")` to `@Pattern("^\\+[0-9]{8,15}$")`, and removed the now-unused `@Digits` import. This was the source of the initial 500s: the persistence-layer constraint still demanded 10 bare digits and rejected the `+`.

**Docs kept in sync:**
- Updated the `InvalidTelephoneException` Javadoc and the `openapi.yml` telephone description to state the E.164 rule.

The PUT/update flow was left untouched — it never normalized the telephone previously, so this change is scoped to the create behavior the specification and tests target.
